diagnostics.message: null_resource.cluster_bootstrap_state writes the cluster_bootstrap_state file ("1" on create, "0" on destroy) that gates whether the bootstrap node is created, so it must only run after aws_instance.bootstrap_node has been created. The source declares depends_on = ["aws_instance.bootstrap_node"], but no dependency is captured in the graph; without it the state file could be written before the bootstrap node exists, breaking the bootstrap-once logic on subsequent applies.

The data-node autoscaling group must be created after the master-node autoscaling group so that data nodes do not start before the master nodes have formed the Elasticsearch cluster. The source declares depends_on = ["aws_autoscaling_group.master_nodes"] on aws_autoscaling_group.data_nodes, but the graph records no dependency on the master ASG (no implicit path exists either), so the intended ordering is not enforced.
